title: 道岔融雪加熱系統~Turnout snow-melting heaters
focus: 道岔加熱熱損融冰與控制遲滯~Turnout heating heat loss ice melting and control hysteresis
summary: 道岔融雪加熱系統以「道岔加熱熱損融冰與控制遲滯」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。道岔加熱需把熱量送到真正阻礙動作的位置，環境風、冰水相變與機械遮蔽會改變效果；耗電增加不能直接證明融雪能力改善。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops turnout heating heat loss ice melting and control hysteresis through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Turnout heating must deliver heat to locations that actually obstruct movement; wind, ice-water phase change and mechanical shielding alter effectiveness, so more electricity does not by itself prove better snow melting. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把道岔融雪加熱系統放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。道岔加熱需把熱量送到真正阻礙動作的位置，環境風、冰水相變與機械遮蔽會改變效果；耗電增加不能直接證明融雪能力改善。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Turnout snow-melting heaters in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Turnout heating must deliver heat to locations that actually obstruct movement; wind, ice-water phase change and mechanical shielding alter effectiveness, so more electricity does not by itself prove better snow melting. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=24 V, R=12 ohm；y=V**2/R=48 W。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=58.08 W。模型邊界：隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=0.2 kg, latent=334 kJ/kg；y=m*latent=66.8 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=73.48 kJ。模型邊界：冰已在相變溫度且全部融化；不含預熱及融水升溫；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=24 V, R=12 ohm; y=V**2/R=48 W. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=58.08 W. Boundary: Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=0.2 kg, latent=334 kJ/kg; y=m*latent=66.8 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=73.48 kJ. Boundary: Ice starts at the phase-change temperature and melts fully; preheating and warming meltwater are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.title: 加熱電功率~Heater electrical power
units.mechanism: 固定電壓下電阻升高會降低純電阻加熱功率。本模型把 V 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 58.08 W。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗。使用隔離低壓電壓電流量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~At fixed voltage, increased resistance lowers resistive heating power. In this model, V is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 58.08 W. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded. Use isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=24 V, R=12 ohm；y=V**2/R=48 W。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=58.08 W。模型邊界：隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=24 V, R=12 ohm; y=V**2/R=48 W. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=58.08 W. Boundary: Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以隔離低壓電壓電流量測區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型加熱器端電壓、電流及接頭溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「加熱電功率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage model heater-terminal voltage, current and connection temperature, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Heater electrical power. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置。這個失效與「加熱電功率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查隔離低壓電壓電流量測，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations. This failure and a measurement bias in Heater electrical power can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations.
units.practice: 重算「加熱電功率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出隔離低壓直流及固定電阻；不計接線端額外損耗如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由接點電阻會把熱量耗在不需要的位置造成偏離的合成觀察，以隔離低壓電壓電流量測說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Heater electrical power, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Isolated low-voltage DC and constant resistance; additional terminal losses are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Contact resistance dissipates heat at unwanted locations. Explain which evidence in isolated low-voltage current and voltage readings distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 冰融化潛熱~Ice melting latent heat
units.title: 冰融化潛熱~Ice melting latent heat
units.mechanism: 融冰必須供應潛熱，即使溫度停留在相變附近。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 73.48 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。冰已在相變溫度且全部融化；不含預熱及融水升溫。使用冰質量與融水量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只計溫升會低估融冰所需熱量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Melting requires latent heat even when temperature remains near the phase change. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 73.48 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ice starts at the phase-change temperature and melts fully; preheating and warming meltwater are excluded. Use ice mass and meltwater mass as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Counting only temperature rise understates melting energy; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.anchor: 理想融冰時間~Ideal melting duration
units.title: 理想融冰時間~Ideal melting duration
units.mechanism: 能量除有效功率是理想時間，下限取決於損失是否忽略。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1837 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。有效功率恆定且能量全部用於所列融化負荷。使用有效熱輸入與融冰完成時刻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；風冷與排水帶熱會延長實際時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Energy divided by useful power gives an ideal time, with ignored losses making it a lower estimate. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1837 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Useful power is constant and all its energy serves the declared melting load. Use useful heat input and melting completion time as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Wind cooling and warm drainage extend real duration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=66.8 kJ, P=40 W；y=E*1000/P=1670 s。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=1837 s。模型邊界：有效功率恆定且能量全部用於所列融化負荷；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=66.8 kJ, P=40 W; y=E*1000/P=1670 s. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=1837 s. Boundary: Useful power is constant and all its energy serves the declared melting load; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以有效熱輸入與融冰完成時刻區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型有效熱功率、剩餘冰量及完成時間建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「理想融冰時間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use useful heat input and melting completion time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage model useful thermal power, remaining ice and completion time, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Ideal melting duration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

units.title: 對流熱損量~Convective heat loss
units.mechanism: 對流熱損取決於暴露面積與環境條件。本模型把 h 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 66 W。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。暴露面積、換熱係數及溫差固定；不含輻射和導熱。使用表面氣溫與風況作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；風速增加會使原有效功率不足，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Convection loss depends on exposed area and environmental conditions. In this model, h is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 66 W. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Exposed area, heat-transfer coefficient and temperature difference are constant; radiation and conduction are excluded. Use surface-air temperature and wind conditions as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Increased wind can make previously adequate power insufficient; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=15 W/m2K, A=0.2 m2, dT=20 K；y=h*A*dT=60 W。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=66 W。模型邊界：暴露面積、換熱係數及溫差固定；不含輻射和導熱；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=15 W/m2K, A=0.2 m2, dT=20 K; y=h*A*dT=60 W. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=66 W. Boundary: Exposed area, heat-transfer coefficient and temperature difference are constant; radiation and conduction are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以表面氣溫與風況區分模型與觀察，先用模型表面與空氣溫度、風速及暴露面積建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「對流熱損量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use surface-air temperature and wind conditions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.verify: 本單元以雪深面積與密度樣本區分模型與觀察，先用模型覆雪面積、深度網格及定容雪樣質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「降雪水當量負荷」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use snow depth, area and density samples to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model snow-covered area, depth grid and fixed-volume snow-sample mass, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Snow water-equivalent load. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只按雪深判斷負荷會忽略濕雪。這個失效與「降雪水當量負荷」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查雪深面積與密度樣本，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Depth-only estimates overlook wet-snow mass. This failure and a measurement bias in Snow water-equivalent load can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check snow depth, area and density samples rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只按雪深判斷負荷會忽略濕雪~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Depth-only estimates overlook wet-snow mass.
units.practice: 重算「降雪水當量負荷」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出雪深與雪密度在面積內均勻；結果是質量而非水當量厚度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只按雪深判斷負荷會忽略濕雪造成偏離的合成觀察，以雪深面積與密度樣本說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Snow water-equivalent load, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Snow depth and density are uniform over area; the result is mass rather than water-equivalent depth. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Depth-only estimates overlook wet-snow mass. Explain which evidence in snow depth, area and density samples distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 感測器偏差餘量~Sensor-bias reserve
units.mechanism: 正偏差會讓控制器以為比實際更溫暖。本模型把 target 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加攝氏一度，輸出增加為 2.8 degC。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。偏差定義為顯示減真值且為常數；溫差以開爾文相減。使用獨立參考溫度與控制讀值作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；感測器貼附不良會增加環境偏差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Positive bias makes the controller believe conditions are warmer than reality. In this model, target is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one degree celsius means the output increases to 2.8 degC. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Bias is indicated minus true temperature and constant; a kelvin temperature difference is subtracted. Use independent reference temperature and control reading as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Poor sensor attachment increases ambient bias; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：target=3 degC, bias=1.2 K；y=target-bias=1.8 degC。只把 target 增加攝氏一度，y=2.8 degC。模型邊界：偏差定義為顯示減真值且為常數；溫差以開爾文相減；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: target=3 degC, bias=1.2 K; y=target-bias=1.8 degC. Increasing only target with an increase of one degree Celsius gives y=2.8 degC. Boundary: Bias is indicated minus true temperature and constant; a kelvin temperature difference is subtracted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以獨立參考溫度與控制讀值區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型控制讀值、獨立溫度基準及貼附狀態建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「感測器偏差餘量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use independent reference temperature and control reading to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage model control reading, independent temperature reference and attachment condition, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sensor-bias reserve. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
